fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-bd671b3d at 2bde24d9: read the diff (internal/daemon/roundrobin.go fills slots in three tiers via ProjectPick.Continues/Queued; internal/api/daemon_projects.go daemonDemand reports the continuation and queued-start counts). Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/daemon/...: ok, incl. TestRoundRobinContinuationsFirst (maxRuns 3, 2 running, A turn next with 2 ready, B 1 continuation -> [Bc]; 2 free slots, A queued start+ready, B continuation -> [Bc As]) and TestRoundRobinContinuationPerProjectMax, and the old cases TestRoundRobinAcrossProjects/PerProjectMax/RotatesAcrossPolls still pass unchanged. The repo test for 'else its start' only used a roadmap pick (Queued 0), so I checked it in a scratch copy of roundrobin.go: A at max with a continuation, B with a true queued start -> [B Bs]; with C also holding a continuation -> [C Cc]; the tier order holds whatever after is. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-round-robin|daemon-continue-slot)$': both PASS (run with the run's RHIZA_* and GOTMPDIR unset, because GOTMPDIR under ~/code/rhiza/.git makes rhiza init in a script find the host repo; that is environmental, not caused by this change). go vet ./internal/api ./internal/daemon: clean.
